note: Small private park on 63 wooded acres around a 12-acre fishing lake, 3 mi off I-135 south of Salina (last 1.3 mi gravel): 20 RV sites with water and electric to 50-amp, sandy swimming beach, docks. Posted $40 a night; Passport America and other clubs accepted. A summer 'Weekender' package ($300/month, 3-month minimum) lets families leave an RV on site; nightly stays are open to the public. Campers report sewer was not at their sites in 2023-2024 despite the 'full hookups' wording. --Claude
summary: Operator site (©2003-2007) read: $40/night, 20 sites, water/sewer/50 A, reservation request form, summer Weekender package. Sewer cleared (campers 2023-24 say none). Waterfront lakeview kept (lakefront lead). Pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview kept (lakefront lead): the rig row sits under trees at the top of an open sand beach ~20-40 m from the lake's west shore; the beach is an open apron but the rigs are under canopy and no site map or photo shows which sites face the water, so not upgraded. A small lake (12 acres) - the pond line is not an issue at that size.

SEWER CLEARED: the operator page (copyright 2003-2007) says full hookups, but 2023-2024 RV Life campers at three different sites (incl. a pull-through and B6) record 'sewer no'. Electric 50 and water kept from the operator page.

PRICE: posted $40/night (undated, 2003-2007 site); campers paid $20 (5/2024, no discount), $20 (6/2024 military), $25 (7/2024 Passport America). Under US$50 either way; the stored fees ($40) left as is - the posted figure may be stale-high.

LONG-STAY: Weekender package $300/month, 3-month minimum, RVs left over the summer, up to 3 nights/week. Nightly stays are taken (reservation form, club discounts, 2024 overnight campers), and AWH ruled 2026-10-03 the membership is long-term only with nightly open to the public. ~12 rigs on imagery out of 20 sites, some likely weekenders. Keep; borderline only if the weekenders fill the park.

PRESENCE: website http://www.lakesiderec.org/ (old but live; reservations page http://www.lakesiderec.org/reservations.html); phone 785-342-2561 (site, Google). Google 'Lakeside Family Resort' 4.2/44. Weak spot: a 7/2024 reviewer couldn't get anyone to answer the phone in 5 days.
PIN: stored 38.6518,-97.5932 sits on the rig loop; fine. SAND: a swimming beach only; rigs are on the wooded loop, not on the beach - not a sand-rule case. ACCESS: 1.3 mi of maintained gravel.
